rows.Origin:
Bred by Hans Jürgen Evers (1940-2007) (Germany, 1998).
Introduced in Germany by Rosen-Tantau/Tantau Roses in 1998 as 'Ashram'.
rows.Bloom: Apricot - orange. Mild, fruity fragrance. up to 30 petals. Average diameter 4.75". Very large, double (17-25 petals), high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Can be used for beds and borders, cut flower or garden. Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) . Can be grown in the ground or in a container (container requires winter protection).
